Welcome onboard Kaitaki!

With three lounges, an eatery, bar, cafés, and a number of viewing decks taking in the sights of the beautiful Marlborough Sounds, Kaitaki aims to please. 

We took the opportunity to refurbish a couple of areas onboard, including the new Island Bar and Café and Pelorus Jack Lounge. 

Cruise in style and sail to the other side with Interislander!

🔍 Find us on https://instagram.com/interislander_nz & https://facebook.com/Interislander

⛴️ Book now on https://interislander.co.nz

We are the original Cook Strait Ferry. We sail between the North and South Islands (Wellington and Picton) every day, carrying passengers and freight. Along with the breathtaking views, enjoy our locally sourced cuisine, cinemas, free kids activities and premium lounges.

The Warratahs onboard Kaitaki

Our iconic music video 'Cruisin' on the Interislander' was released 32 years ago - and it was an absolute privilege to welcome the original artist of the song - The Warratahs - back for a day full of entertainment, fantastic music, and plenty of smiling faces onboard.

To our people and our customers - THANK YOU! It's been a pleasure to take you safely across Cook Strait for 60 years, and we look forward to the many more to come. 

#interislander60years

🔍 Find us on https://instagram.com/interislander_nz & https://facebook.com/Interislander

⛴️ Book now on https://interislander.co.nz

Law Commission - Review of Adult Decision-Making Capacity Law - Webinar 7 Dec 2022

The webinar provides a short overview of this review and the consultation, answers some common questions, and provides information about how you can have your say.
